intro: A magical interactive 3D video book about friendship, kindness and bravery!
description:
On a rainy afternoon, Alicia steps through a freezing Looking-Glass into a fading world that has lost its colour and warmth. Alongside two tiny companions, Snugglet and Mira, she journeys through whimsical lands to confront King Cozy, a lonely bear-king who is hoarding the world's sparkles. Ultimately, the smallest hero saves the day, restoring light and joy to the realm.

Features:
• A cinematic visual novel brought to life with feature-film quality 3D animation.
• A fully voiced interactive 3D Video Book for ages 4–8.
• 10 chapters: Over 10,000 words of story.
• Original instrumental soundtrack: 29 cheerful kids' pop tracks.
• Full voice acting for every character and the narrator (17 distinct voices).
• Full colour image gallery to use as wallpaper or background.
• Five karaoke songs to enjoy singing about history.
• Short sessions, perfect for one chapter per evening, read together or alone.
• Themes: friendship, kindness, courage, and set in a magical mirror world.
• PEGI 3 · USK 0 · ESRB Everyone, appropriate for all ages.
• No ads · No in-app purchases · No frightening content · No sad ending.
